outcome: neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) stay >24 hours
cohort: 68,966 planned community births in the United States from the MANA Statistics Project, 2012-2018.
finding: Higher grades of fetal macrosomia were associated in a dose-response manner with increased odds of negative maternal and neonatal outcomes, including postpartum hemorrhage, cesarean birth, and neonatal birth injury.
birth_weight: Normal birthweight (2500-3999 g), Grade 1 macrosomia (4000-4499 g), Grade 2 macrosomia (4500-4999 g), and Grade 3 macrosomia (>=5000 g)
